title: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models

cases.title: Reversed Rotation
cases.headline: Turn away. Turn back.
cases.description: An inverse rotation brings an observed view back into sight.

cases.title: Full Rotation
cases.headline: One turn. The same place.
cases.description: A full rotation tests whether the scene survives a complete change of view.

cases.title: Forward and Look Back
cases.headline: Move forward. Look back.
cases.description: After moving to a new location, turn to recover the scene from the opposite direction.

cases.title: New-Viewpoint Revisit
cases.headline: A new viewpoint. A familiar scene.
cases.description: Observe the blue-and-white building, explore elsewhere, then see it from a displaced viewpoint.
